js-01.title: JavaScript Module 1 Quiz
js-01.description: Test your understanding of JavaScript variables and data types.

questions.question: Which keyword is commonly used to declare a variable whose value should not be reassigned?
questions.explanation: const declares a variable binding that cannot be reassigned after initialization.

questions.question: Which JavaScript data type represents text?
questions.explanation: A String represents text in JavaScript.

questions.question:
What is the value of the following code?

let age = 17;
questions.explanation: The value 17 is a number, so the variable age contains a Number value.

questions.question: Which value represents a Boolean?
questions.explanation: true and false are the two Boolean values in JavaScript. "true" is a String, not a Boolean.

questions.question: Which operator can be used to determine the data type of a value?
questions.explanation: The typeof operator returns a String indicating the type of a value.

js-02.title: JavaScript Module 2 Quiz
js-02.description: Test your understanding of JavaScript functions and scope.

questions.question: What is the main purpose of a function?
questions.explanation: A function groups instructions that can be executed when the function is called.

questions.question: Which syntax correctly declares a JavaScript function?
questions.explanation: A standard JavaScript function declaration uses the function keyword followed by the function name and parentheses.

questions.question: What is a parameter?
options: A value returned by a function
A variable defined in a function's parameter list
The name of a JavaScript file
questions.explanation: A parameter is a variable defined in a function declaration that receives a value when the function is called.

questions.question: What does return do inside a function?
options: It sends a value back from the function
questions.explanation: The return statement ends the function's execution and can provide a value back to the code that called the function.

questions.question: What does scope determine in JavaScript?
options: Where a variable can be accessed
The size of an HTML element
The font used on a webpage
questions.explanation: Scope determines where variables and other identifiers can be accessed in a program.
